foc198Rule.goRuleContext: the cost axis is a MEDIAN comparison: win iff median arm A < median arm B x 0.85 (protocol, the win/loss rule). GO iff both axes win AND zero axes in regression > 5%.
foc198Rule.proposal: Score FOC-198's arm-B cost on the cost axis at 0.009 - the smallest surviving cumulative snapshot, the only number the record can defend without inventing data, and a floor the session total cannot go below. Rationale: with the 9 known ground-truth B values the median is 0.1168; a low B_198 drops the 10-entry median to 0.1126 (the hardest bar A can face), a high B_198 raises it to 0.1277. The floor is the direction that makes GO harder - what 'przeciw GO' asks for. If the cost axis still wins with B_198 at its floor, the win does not depend on the lost transcript.
foc198Rule.alternative: exclude FOC-198 from the cost-axis median (n=9) and mark the axis win* with the exclusion named. Invents nothing, but the 9-entry median 0.1168 is an easier bar than 0.1126 - less conservative against GO.
foc198Rule.chosen: A - score FOC-198’s arm-B cost on the cost axis at 0.009, the smallest surviving cumulative snapshot.
foc198Rule.rationale: Mateusz, 2026-10-12: "foc 198 - opcja A". The floor is the conservative direction ("przeciw GO"): the 10-entry median drops to 0.1126 vs 0.1168 without FOC-198, so the cost axis faces the hardest bar the record can defend. If the axis still wins at the floor, the win does not depend on the lost transcript.
foc198Rule.rejectedAlternative: B - exclude FOC-198 from the cost-axis median (n=9) and mark the axis win*. Invents nothing, but 0.1168 is an easier bar than 0.1126 - less conservative against GO.
foc198Rule.decisionOwner: Mateusz. DECIDED 2026-10-12 (option A). FOC-759 AC2 is closed by this ruling; the cost axis counts FOC-198 at 0.009.
